quality_bar.rule: Nothing may look like a placeholder. Illustrated art (characters, painterly scenes) comes from an image model or the user; code builds only what code can do at reference quality (gradients, rays, bloom, particles, paper, wood, torn edges, shadows, vignette, type, icons, motion graphics).
automatic_fails: placeholder look (primitive shapes, faceless characters, untextured large fills)
text crossing a border or rule
jagged or blurry edges at output size

metric_targets.measured_at: reference scale (854x480) on matching regions; script analysis/scripts/b04_lookdev_metrics.py
metric_targets.edge_density_definition: Canny on luma, averaged over threshold pairs 30/75, 45/110, 60/150, 80/200 (a single 60/150 pair is unstable: a ~5-level change in a wall seam flipped the ratio 1.01 -> 0.24)
metric_targets.fine_texture_definition: std of luma minus Gaussian(sigma 1 ref px)
metric_targets.regions_note: keep measurement boxes off thin features that sit on the box edge (a 1 px offset of a dashed rule swung one region 0.4 -> 2.3); exclude pending illustrated art and the reference character
metric_targets.blind_review: fresh subagent, unlabeled A/B crop pairs at equal scale (2-3x), key stored outside its reach; iterate until only expected differences remain

quality_bar.blind_review: fresh subagent compares unlabeled A/B crop pairs (same scale and upscale for both); iterate until only expected differences remain (different character, different words)
build_rules: Never build a large glow or vignette from an 8-bit SVG/CSS gradient: compute it in float and dither it into an image (b03_plates.py); a coherent 1-level ring survives a +-1.5-level dither after the 2x downscale
Thin structural lines that must stay crisp under camera zoom (plank seams, rules) are vector strokes, not baked into textures
Verify every reviewer claim about the reference by measurement before changing anything (three blind-review rounds contradicted each other on paper burn, pin, knots, bird weight and tear)
Screen-space vignettes go beneath foreground props that carry their own lighting (the wanted poster), above the background they darken

render_settings.codec: libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -profile:v high, yuv420p, BT.709 primaries/trc/matrix tags, tv range
render_settings.audio: AAC-LC 48 kHz 320 kbps (final); reference audio only for calibration timing
render_settings.geometry_units: SVG viewBox in reference pixels (854x480) so every coordinate in blueprint.json renders at any resolution
render_settings.encode_check: decode the MP4 with in_color_matrix=bt709 and compare against the PNG masters scaled with the same filter (analysis/scripts/b06_encode_compare.py); target mean pixel dE2000 < 1.0 and no systematic RGB offset > 1
render_settings.dithering: all generated gradients/plates get triangular dither before 8-bit quantisation; SVG gradients sit over dithered plates

fonts.policy: strict: render/src/lib/fontsStrict.ts loads every family with FontFace, checks document.fonts.check() and verifies glyph metrics differ from fallback stacks; any failure cancels the render
fonts.text_fit: layout computed offline from the font files (PIL advance widths + tracking) into render/src/data/*_layout.json; each string is auto-shrunk to its container minus a 4 % margin and the build fails if any string is outside its container

sources.illustrated: image model with reference attachments (or the user's phone app when no API key exists)
sources.icons: hand-drawn SVG pictograms in the badge style (no primitive stand-ins)

asset_pipeline.generation_size: largest the model allows; every layer at >= 2x its on-screen size at 1080p (hero bust >= 2100 px tall)
post: key out flat green (#00FF00) or use the alpha channel
defringe: erode alpha 1 px, decontaminate edge colour from the key colour, 0.6 px feather
upscale 2-4x with Real-ESRGAN (anime model) when below the 2x rule
colour-match to the style-bible palette (per-channel curve fit on skin/fabric patches)
split into animation layers (character / far / mid / near)
asset_pipeline.consistency: character sheet first (A01); every later pose prompt attaches the sheet; poster prints reuse the same art through the printTone filter (monochrome sepia duotone, multiply over paper)
asset_pipeline.prompt_template: <SUBJECT>. STYLE (match the attached references' style exactly but do not copy any character's identity): flat 2D cartoon illustration for an animated explainer; bold warm near-black outlines (#130b01) that taper at the tips, thick on silhouettes (~1% of image height) and thin inside; cel shading with exactly three tones per material; hard cast shadows; small hard-edged highlights; tapered hatching strokes in groups of 2-4 for wrinkles/texture; hair and beards as many short strokes; fabric detail (stitching, pinstripes, buckles). <LIGHTING>. <BACKGROUND: transparent, or flat pure green #00FF00>. No text, no letters, no labels, no watermark.
asset_pipeline.asset_list_when_no_api: analysis/assets_to_generate/ASSET_LIST.md format: file name, copy-ready prompt, attachments, aspect, background
